set.body:
Parent epic: bd-01KXZZZWCEEDVD963AZA40FHE7

Objective:
Freeze the narrow scientific and architectural contract before implementation.

Required decisions:
- Specify the runwise moment equations H = Z transpose Z, G = Z transpose X, and XtX; the contrast effect matrix; the residual matrix; the generalized root; and the root-to-correlation transformation.
- Define the version-one estimand as leave-one-independent-run-out largest-root canonical contrast analysis with weights learned only from training runs and frozen on the held-out run.
- Distinguish temporal nuisance and whitening from trial-space covariates; record preparation scope and residual degrees of freedom.
- Specify sign and repeated-root behavior without promising identifiable vectors where only a subspace is identified.
- Confirm that ordinary paired CCA and directed RRR remain owned by bd-01KXSGZ3JXDTCAKBHWN8G549B8.

Gale boundary:
Verify against the exact pinned Gale revision that dense symmetric-definite eigensolve, matrix carriers, property evidence, selection, residual diagnostics, and JVM/JS behavior suffice. If a missing capability is genuinely general, open and land it in Gale and advance the immutable pin. Do not add a generic duplicate to scalafim.

Oracles:
Commit a tiny analytic case, an explicit dense projector implementation for tests, and fixed fmrireg.cca reference fixtures with documented matrix orientations.

Acceptance:
A concise architecture note names every matrix, invariant, owner, fold scope, error condition, and completion oracle; the Gale gap list is empty or routed upstream; and no production implementation begins under an ambiguous estimand.
set.title: CCA 0: freeze the minimal estimand, Gale boundary, and independent oracles
